judge.protocol: separate semantic correctness and evidence grounding passes

embedding_controls.dense_queries: encode_queries with BGE's published query prompt
embedding_controls.lightrag_callback: encode for all embedding requests; the shared encode_queries method is not used

pipeline.thresholds_note: measured on ContractNLI; the sweep is in THRESHOLDS.md. insufficient ships at 0.0 because 0.3 caught 20 more of 322 null questions and refused 43 more of 358 answerable ones. sufficient was flat from 0.2 to 1.0 within sampling error and stays at 0.6

decision_comparison.inference_limit: Descriptive paired test only: questions within a contract are correlated; this is not contract-level population inference.

answer_correctness_comparison.inference_limit: Descriptive paired test only: questions within a contract are correlated; this is not contract-level population inference.

limitations: Fixed leading contracts, not a random or full-corpus sample.
Same-model generation and judging can share errors; annotated null labels may omit valid answers.
Equal passage caps do not guarantee equal realized text lengths; both arm budgets are reported.
Embedding query conventions differ between adapters; this compares implemented configurations and does not isolate graph structure alone.

recovery.method: 41 unique completed keyword response rows form final cache suffix before any generation
recovery.limitation: Completed unique requests are a lower bound; retry billing, cache hits and timing were not persisted.

index_diagnostics.interpretation: Warning events can repeat during retries. Malformed graph records limit conclusions about the method; a processed document status does not establish extraction quality.
